claims: Dave Ramsey advises against waiting for a housing market crash.
Dave Ramsey argues that low inventory keeps prices high.
Dave Ramsey advocates for buying a home only when debt-free.
Dave Ramsey advocates for a 15-year fixed mortgage where payments are under 25% of take-home pay.
Dave Ramsey believes housing prices will not drop significantly due to a persistent, long-term inventory shortage.
Dave Ramsey warns against trying to perfectly time the market.
Dave Ramsey urges focusing on personal financial readiness.
Dave Ramsey encourages purchasing now if financially stable, even with higher rates, rather than waiting for a potential dip.
Dave Ramsey argues the market is "clogged".
Dave Ramsey suggests limiting institutional investors to boost supply.
Dave Ramsey suggests raising capital gains exemptions to boost supply.
Dave Ramsey advises clearing all consumer debt (credit cards, cars, student loans) first.
Dave Ramsey advises using only a 15-year fixed-rate mortgage, never 30-year.
Dave Ramsey's 25% rule states monthly payments should not exceed 25% of take-home pay.
Dave Ramsey states a 20% down payment is ideal to avoid PMI.
Dave Ramsey states 5–10% down payment is acceptable for first-time buyers.
Dave Ramsey advises retaining 3–6 months of expenses in savings after closing.
The information above is based on summarized views of Dave Ramsey and his team as of early 2026.
